annotations.exact_quote: Inaccurate Label Distribution Learning with Dependency Noise
annotations.reason_zh: 标题明确以不准确标签分布学习为研究任务，学习标签分布预测。

annotations.exact_quote: tackle the challenges posed by noise in label distribution learning, which arise from dependencies on instances and labels
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要将标签分布中的噪声作为核心研究问题，属于不准确的标签分布监督。

annotations.exact_quote: modeling the inaccurate label distribution matrix as a combination of the true label distribution and a noise matrix influenced by specific instances and labels
annotations.reason_zh: 监督标签分布被建模为真实分布与噪声矩阵的组合，说明以不准确的监督信号为研究条件。
摘要说明在实例到真实标签分布的映射中显式引入标签相关性。

annotations.exact_quote: we employ graph regularization to align the topological structures of the input and output spaces
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要在优化中采用图正则化对齐输入与输出空间的拓扑结构，施加几何一致性约束。

annotations.exact_quote: ensuring accurate reconstruction of the true label distribution matrix
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要以从含噪观测中重建真实标签分布矩阵为目标，符合从污染观测恢复原始数值。
